quests.title: First Blood
quests.description: You woke up in this valley with sand in your mouth and no memory of the fall. Farseer Nakhtar found you first - orc, older than he looks, the kind of calm that comes from having seen worse mornings than this one. He didn't ask where you came from. He asked if you could still hold a weapon. That's the only question that matters to him right now. The valley is thick with Mottled Boars - stupid, aggressive, and exactly the right size of problem for someone who doesn't yet know what their own arms can do. Kill five of them. Not for the valley's sake. For yours.
quests.accept_text: Oh - another one from that blue planet everyone keeps talking about. Don't worry about it, it happens more than you'd think. What matters is whether you can still fight, whatever you were before. Boars won't kill you if you're paying attention. They'll certainly try. Go find out which kind of person you still are.
quests.turn_in_text: Five down, and you're still standing without a limp. Good - your body remembers things your head hasn't caught up to yet. That happens to all of you, the ones who fall into this valley instead of walking into it. Rest here a moment if you need it. There's more work, if you want it, and I think you do.

unique_item_defs.name: Sandworn Fang
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Smaller than a kitchen knife, yet infinitely more dangerous.
unique_item_defs.label: Dagger (Agi)

unique_item_defs.name: Novice's Kindling Rod
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Back home magic didn't exist, but now you harness it freely.
unique_item_defs.label: Staff (Int)

unique_item_defs.name: First Light Shortblade
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: You've never swung a blade before, but in your hands, this feels right.
unique_item_defs.label: Sword (Str)

quests.title: Scorpid Trouble
quests.description: The scorpid nest in the north-east of the valley has been unusually restless for three days running, and Nakhtar doesn't believe in coincidence. Something's stirred them - could be nothing, could be the same wrongness that's been creeping into this valley since before you arrived. Either way, six fewer Scorpid Workers means six fewer things trying to sting a recruit half to death on the road. He's not sending you in blind - scorpids are slow, predictable, easy to read once you've seen the pattern. This is the last easy lesson he's got for you.
quests.accept_text: The scorpids have been pushing further from the nest than they should, and I don't like things that change their habits for no reason. Thin them out - six workers, no more chasing that's needed. Watch their tails, not their claws. That's where the lesson is.
quests.turn_in_text: That'll keep them honest a while. You watched the tails, like I said - good, you listen. That's rarer than it should be. Now. You've done real work for this valley, twice now, and I don't say that lightly. Take something for it - pick whatever suits how you fight. You've earned the choice, not just the reward.

unique_item_defs.name: Carapace-Splitter
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Back home this was a museum exhibit; here, it's a problem solver.
unique_item_defs.label: Mace (Str)

unique_item_defs.name: Chitin-Bound Wand
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: You used to think these were just plastic toys at theme parks, until spark came out the tip.
unique_item_defs.label: Wand (Int)

unique_item_defs.name: Chitin-Cleaver
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: It lacks the clean balance of a golf club, but it certainly gets the message across.
unique_item_defs.label: 2H Axe (Str)

unique_item_defs.name: Stinger-Studded Bracers
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Spikes where the stingers were. Plates where they'd hit.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Bracers (Str)

quests.title: Into the Den
quests.description: Elder Kuraw has no patience for Nakhtar's gentler approach to newcomers. In his experience, the valley teaches best when you're standing in it, not being told about it. The Den is a shallow cave just west of camp - nothing in there should kill a careful person, which is exactly why he wants you to go first, before anywhere that could. He's not interested in a report of what you fought. He wants to know what you noticed: the sound of water somewhere you didn't expect it, a draft where there shouldn't be one, the shape of a room before you're standing in the middle of it with something already swinging. That's the difference between someone who survives this valley and someone who gets remembered by it.
quests.accept_text: Nakhtar talks. I'd rather you see something with your own eyes and tell me what you found. The Den is close, shallow, forgiving - as caves go. And that's the other thing: caves aren't like open ground. Tight rooms, narrow tunnels - you step into the wrong corner and you'll have two or three of them on you at once instead of one. It's not a warning to scare you off. It's just how caves fight. Go in. Look around properly - not just at what's trying to kill you. Come back and tell me what you noticed.
quests.turn_in_text: You're still in one piece, and better - you came back describing a place, not just a fight. That instinct is worth more than any weapon I could hand you. Most people who wake up in this valley never learn to look past what's directly in front of them. You're already ahead of most.

quests.title: The Nest Guardian
quests.description: The Den's guardian creature has grown territorial enough that it's no longer content to lurk - it's started patrolling, which in Kuraw's estimation makes it either a genuine problem or a very useful lesson, and possibly both. He's not sugarcoating this one: it's not the worst thing in this valley, not close, but it is the first thing that can actually kill you if you get sloppy. Everything before this has been boars and scorpids - creatures that punish carelessness with a scar. This will punish carelessness with your life, if you let it. He wants you to feel that difference now, on his terms, in a fight he's confident you can win, rather than discovering it later somewhere he isn't.
quests.accept_text: It's a soft boss, as these things go in this valley. But it's still a boss, and you haven't fought one yet. Don't get comfortable just because I called it soft. Go find out what your hands do when the stakes are real.
quests.turn_in_text: You did it. However your hands are shaking right now, if they are - remember exactly how this felt. That was your first real fight in this world, and it will not be your last. The next one won't announce itself as a lesson the way this one did. Carry that with you.

unique_item_defs.name: Guardian's Broken Tusk
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: You've only ever used one of these on firewood, but targets are targets.
unique_item_defs.label: Axe (Str)

unique_item_defs.name: Denwalker's Greatblade
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: In movie props this would weigh forty pounds, but here you lift it like a feather.
unique_item_defs.label: 2H Sword (Str)

unique_item_defs.name: Guardian-Cracked Maul
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: You used to struggle with heavy groceries - now you're swinging a cinder block on a stick.
unique_item_defs.label: 2H Mace (Str)

unique_item_defs.name: Carapace Breastplate
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A guardian's own plating, hammered flat and riveted.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Chest (Str/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Brood-Warden's Hauberk
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Light, flexible, and smells faintly of damp stone.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Chest (Agi/Int)

quests.title: Fel Taint
quests.description: The Valley Grunt keeping watch near the Burning Blade Coven doesn't bother hiding how much he hates this posting. Demons don't belong in a valley this young - he's served three seasons on this line and never once saw so much as a whiff of fel energy until last week. Now there's a cave full of it, crawling with Vile Familiars that answer to something worse still inside. He's not asking you to solve the whole problem. He's asking you to thin the herd - four familiars, enough to buy the valley some breathing room while whoever's actually in charge figures out what opened that door and why it opened here, of all places. Don't go past the familiars alone. That part matters.
quests.accept_text: Demons. In this valley, of all places. I've stood this watch three seasons and never seen one before last week - now there's a cave full of them. Whatever's in there isn't from around here either, kind of like you, maybe, though I doubt it's as friendly. Start with the familiars. Don't go deeper without backup.
quests.turn_in_text: Four down, and the cave's gone quiet - for now. Quiet isn't the same as safe, and I want you to remember that before you get comfortable. Whatever's still in there commanding them hasn't so much as flinched. That's the part that keeps me up at night, if orcs still dreamed the way you people do.

unique_item_defs.name: Coven-Forged Cleaver
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: The fel-etched edge still hasn't cooled all the way down, even wrapped in the sheath.
unique_item_defs.label: Sword (Str)

unique_item_defs.name: Familiar-Hide Grips
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Still faintly warm. You try very hard not to think about why.
unique_item_defs.label: Fist Weapon (Agi)

unique_item_defs.name: Familiar-Bone Charm
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Warm to the touch for reasons it won't share.
unique_item_defs.label: Necklace (Int/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Taint-Warded Leggings
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Stitched with a ward you can't read. It hasn't failed you yet.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Legs (Int/Spi)

quests.title: Baneshadow
quests.description: Whatever commands the Burning Blade Coven's demons has a name now, dragged out of a captured familiar before it stopped answering questions entirely: Yarrog Baneshadow. The Grunt has seen what happens to careless fighters who go looking for cave bosses without a plan, and he won't send you in blind. Baneshadow doesn't fight fair - he'll keep summoning familiars the longer the fight drags on, building a crowd around himself while you're still trying to reach him. The trick, such as it is, isn't cleverness. It's discipline: ignore the noise, focus the head of the snake, and don't let the fight turn into a war of attrition you can't win. Kill him, and whatever foothold the fel has carved into this valley dies with him.
quests.accept_text: He summons more of them the longer the fight runs - don't let them stack up on you, or you'll be fighting the whole coven at once. Focus him, finish it fast. I'd go myself if the valley could spare the watch. It can't. So it's you.
quests.turn_in_text: Baneshadow is dead, and the valley is a little less wrong than it was this morning. I watched that fight end from the ridge - you didn't hesitate once. Whatever you were before you fell into this world, you fight like someone who's done this before, in some life or another. Maybe that's just how it works for people like you. Well fought, all the same. Truly.

unique_item_defs.name: Baneshadow's Edge
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Still warm with fel heat. It shouldn't be - he's been dead a full minute.
unique_item_defs.label: Sword (Str)

unique_item_defs.name: Yarrog's Last Fang
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Curved like a fang, and about as friendly.
unique_item_defs.label: Dagger (Agi)

unique_item_defs.name: Coven-Marked Staff
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: The fel sigils are already fading now that he's gone. Small mercies.
unique_item_defs.label: Staff (Int)

unique_item_defs.name: Baneshadow's Cowl
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: The cowl speaks in a language you do not want to learn. It has stopped, for now.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Helm (Int/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Fel-Seared Bracers
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Burned into shape and quenched in something dark.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Bracers (Str/Sta)

quests.title: Sagewood Petals
quests.description: Old Marta has tended more disoriented strangers through this valley than she can count, and she's long past the point of prying into where any of them came from. What she needs right now is practical: five Sagewood Petals, gathered fresh from the sprites that guard Sagewood Grove, for a remedy she's been brewing for the recruits who keep stumbling back into camp half-poisoned by scorpid venom. The sprites don't give the petals up easily - they startle and scatter the moment anything gets close, dropping what they're carrying only in the panic of the moment. It's not dangerous work, just patient work, and you look steady enough on your feet to manage both.
quests.accept_text: You've got that look - the one they all have when they first wake up here, like the ground itself doesn't feel quite real yet. It passes, given time. In the meantime, the sagewood sprites drop petals when they're startled badly enough to run. Bring me five, fresh as you can manage - they wilt fast.
quests.turn_in_text: Still fragrant - you were careful with these, good. Most recruits crush half of what they bring me without noticing. You'll do fine here, better than fine maybe, if you keep paying that kind of attention to the small things. It's usually the small things that keep people alive out here.

quests.title: Hounds of the Coven
quests.description: The demons infesting the Burning Blade Coven brought hounds with them - Felstalker Whelps and their smaller cousins, Fel Pups, both quick, both vicious, both bred for exactly one purpose. The Valley Grunt wants their numbers thinned alongside the familiars, and he doesn't much care which of the two you find first - a dead hound is a dead hound, whelp or pup. Kill 6 of either, in any combination, while you're already in there dealing with the rest.
quests.accept_text: You'll see the hounds before you see the familiars, most likely - whelps and pups both, running in packs. Doesn't matter which you kill. Six dead hounds is six dead hounds, whichever kind they are.
quests.turn_in_text: Good. Fewer teeth in that cave now. Between you and whoever else the valley sends in, maybe we actually clear it out before something worse decides to move in behind the demons.

unique_item_defs.name: Whelp-Fang Dirk
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Filed down from something that used to have teeth of its own.
unique_item_defs.label: Dagger (Agi)

unique_item_defs.name: Coven-Hound Sling
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Every pack has a runt that breaks off from the others. This is what you use to make sure it doesn't get back up.
unique_item_defs.label: Thrown (Agi)

unique_item_defs.name: Hound-Hide Boots
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Scuffed in places no boot should be.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Boots (Agi)

unique_item_defs.name: Packleader's Spaulders
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Taken from something with a very bad temper.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Shoulders (Agi/Sta)

quests.title: Beyond the Valley
quests.description: Farseer Nakhtar has watched you long enough to know the valley doesn't have much left to teach you. The boars, the scorpid, even the coven's demons - you've handled what this place can throw at a green recruit, and there's a wider world waiting past the ridge that won't wait forever. Razor Hill sits at the heart of Durotar, the real town where real orcs make their real lives, and Nakhtar says it's time you saw it. Weapons Trainer Grokk holds court there and takes in every recruit who graduates out of this valley - find him, and your training truly begins.
quests.accept_text: Follow the road east out of the valley and keep it under your feet the whole way - Durotar doesn't forgive wandering off it, not yet, not for someone as green as you still are underneath everything you've survived here. Razor Hill sits at the heart of it. Find Grokk. Tell him Nakhtar sent you, though I suspect he'll know the second he sees you carry yourself.
quests.turn_in_text: You made it. Of course you made it - I wouldn't have sent you otherwise. This is farther than most of you get, in either direction of what that means. Go find Grokk properly now. What happens from here isn't mine to teach you anymore.

unique_item_defs.name: Recruit's Valor Cloak
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Dust of three trials still caught in the weave.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloak (Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Nakhtar's Farewell Charm
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A feather and a knot of red cord. He tied it himself.
unique_item_defs.label: Necklace (Int/Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Valley-Forged Band
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Plain, sturdy, and slightly too big. It will fit by Durotar.
unique_item_defs.label: Ring (Str)

unique_item_defs.name: Graduate's Token
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A flat river stone, marked with a single claw-scratch.
unique_item_defs.label: Trinket (Agi)

quests.title: Wanted: Old Tusk
quests.description: Grulnok has watched this ridge for six seasons and he knows every boar on it by its tracks. One set of tracks he doesn't like: a boar the size of a cart, tusks worn yellow, with a habit of walking straight through the training dummies on Sagebrush Flat as if they were an insult. The recruits call it Old Tusk. Grulnok calls it a matter of time before someone's mother gets bad news. Thin out the boars on the flat, and when the old one shows himself, put him down.
quests.accept_text: West of camp, on the flat. You'll know him when you see him - he's the one that doesn't run. Don't fight him on open ground with your back to a hill. Use the dummies. He hates the dummies.
quests.turn_in_text: Tusk's down? Good. Good. That's a lot of years of that animal off the ridge in one afternoon. Take these - the old boar's had them coming since before you woke up.

unique_item_defs.name: Tuskplate Pauldrons
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Two curved tusks, riveted to a strap. Nobody is asking where the third one went.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Shoulders (Str/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Boarbristle Mitts
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Stiff bristles across the knuckles, soft silk where it counts.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Gloves (Int/Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Ridgerunner Bracers
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Cut from the part of the hide that doesn't squeak.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Bracers (Agi/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Heavy Boarhide Belt
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Heavier than it looks and about as comfortable as it sounds.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Belt (Str/Agi)

quests.title: Carrion Circle
quests.description: Torgak can't walk the ridge yet and the carrion birds have noticed. They've started circling the camp in the afternoons, patient as tax collectors, and the jackals that follow them keep creeping closer to the fire. He says it's nothing personal. He says it with the look of someone who has taken it personally. Clear out the vultures and the jackals running with them until the sky gets boring again.
quests.accept_text: They think I'm already dead. I'd like to change their minds. Vultures first - the jackals only get brave when there's something circling. Don't tell Nakhtar I'm giving out quests.
quests.turn_in_text: Quiet sky. You have no idea how nice that is. Take something - Nakhtar says I'm not allowed to hand out coin, but nobody said anything about gear I can't wear anymore.

unique_item_defs.name: Vulture-Feather Cloak
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Lighter than air, warmer than it has any right to be.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloak (Agi/Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Scavenger's Cord
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Everything useful ends up tied to it eventually.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Belt (Agi/Int)

unique_item_defs.name: Bonepicker's Legguards
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Plated with what the birds left behind.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Legs (Str)

unique_item_defs.name: Torgak's Spare Crutch
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: It has a lot of opinions about leaning.
unique_item_defs.label: Staff (Int/Spi)

quests.title: Troubled Waters
quests.description: The spring at the lake south of camp has fed this valley since before the Horde had a name for it, and lately Old Marta can't brew a clean batch with water from it. Marsh skimmers have been skating over the shallows in numbers she's never seen, and the toads are bolder than toads should be. She isn't asking for a massacre - just enough dead things that the water runs clear again.
quests.accept_text: Go south to the lake. Mind the mud, it's deeper than it looks. Skimmers and toads - I don't care which you reach first, I just want the shallows still for an hour.
quests.turn_in_text: Clear water, at last. Smell that? That's a remedy that works. And look at you - hardly wet. You're learning the trick of it faster than most.

unique_item_defs.name: Reed-Wrapped Bracers
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Waterproof, mostly. Fragrant, definitely.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Bracers (Sta/Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Skimmer-Silk Sash
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Spun from something that spends its life on water. It sheds it beautifully.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Belt (Int/Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Springstone Charm
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A smooth stone from the lake bottom. It's calmer than you are.
unique_item_defs.label: Necklace (Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Mudcaked Greaves
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: They've never been clean and never will be. They don't slip, either.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Boots (Str/Spi)

quests.title: The Spring's Warden
quests.description: The skimmers are only the symptom. Something huge has taken up residence at Trailwater Spring - a toad bigger than a boar that the recruits have started calling Old Gulpjaw, mostly in the tone people use for weather. It's been eating whatever drifts in, and now it's eating whatever walks in. Marta needs the spring back. Bring a friend if you can find one. Bring a plan if you can't.
quests.accept_text: He sits at the bottom of the shallows and waits. Don't wade in. Pull him out onto the bank - everything slow is worse in water than out of it.
quests.turn_in_text: Gulpjaw, gone. The water's already settling. You've done this valley more good than you know - and I'll keep telling people so, whether you like it or not.

unique_item_defs.name: Toadleather Hood
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Smells of pond. Keeps the rain out like nothing else.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Helm (Agi/Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Spring-Warden's Mace
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: You've seen cartoon hammers like this. Now you own one.
unique_item_defs.label: Mace (Str/Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Slick-Scale Legwraps
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Water beads right off. So, honestly, does most criticism.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Legs (Int/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Lilypad Buckler
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Surprisingly sturdy for something named after a plant.
unique_item_defs.label: Shield (Sta)

quests.title: Heartwood and Thorn
quests.description: The petals did their job. Now Marta wants the thing that makes the petals worth gathering: heartwood from the old sagewood in the Grove east of camp. Lately the saplings there have started walking - thornroot saplings, quick and mean - and something older has begun to move among them. Bramblethorn the Ancient has been in that grove longer than the valley has had a name. She doesn't ask you to fell it. She asks that it stop.
quests.accept_text: It's the grove's own heart gone sour. Saplings first - they'll tell you where the old one is. Fire works, if you have it. It also makes the grove very angry, so do it quickly.
quests.turn_in_text: The grove's quiet again. Listen to it. That is what a valley sounds like when it isn't being watched. Take something. You've earned more than I'll ever be able to give.

unique_item_defs.name: Sapling-Carved Wand
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: You wave it, things happen. You're choosing not to ask for details.
unique_item_defs.label: Wand (Int)

unique_item_defs.name: Bramblebound Leggings
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Woven so tightly even the thorns couldn't find the gaps.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Legs (Agi/Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Thornroot Spaulders
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Grown, not forged. Doesn't mind the weight.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Shoulders (Agi/Int)

unique_item_defs.name: Greenwarden's Mantle
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Warm, and quietly alive.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Shoulders (Int/Spi)

quests.title: The Brood Below
quests.description: You came back from the Den's mouth with an observant eye. Now Elder Kuraw wants the next lesson: the deeper chambers where the eggs are kept. The Den is a scorpid-and-spider brood cave and its guardians are only as dangerous as the numbers behind them. Thin them out - skitterers and webspinners in the halls, egg tenders in the nursery - so that whatever comes for the guardian does not come into a room full of its children.
quests.accept_text: Caves lie. They tell you the next room is safe because it's quiet. Then you step in and find out why it was quiet. Clear the halls, then the nursery. One room at a time.
quests.turn_in_text: You walk different than you did. Good. Fewer of them behind you means fewer in front. The guardian is next, and it's the last thing in that cave that matters.

unique_item_defs.name: Skitterer-Chitin Helm
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Doesn't fit anyone. Fits you now.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Helm (Str/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Webwoven Gloves
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Sticky on the inside only. Tested.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Gloves (Agi)

unique_item_defs.name: Husk-Plated Vambraces
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Chitin plates over a boiled hide.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Bracers (Str/Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Egg-Tender's Wand
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: It hums when you stand near anything fragile.
unique_item_defs.label: Wand (Int/Spi)

quests.title: Windrift Omens
quests.description: Elder Kuraw reads weather the way other orcs read faces, and the weather in the Windrift Dunes southeast of camp is saying something he doesn't like. Dust devils have been walking the road with intent, and sandpincer crawlers keep pushing up out of the sand where there was nothing before. He wants the dunes quiet before whatever is stirring them decides to finish waking.
quests.accept_text: Southeast, down the road to the dunes. Don't chase the dust. Let it come to you. Sandpincers hide under the surface - if the sand moves, move first.
quests.turn_in_text: Quieter already. I can hear the road again. There's one more place that's wrong, and it's the worst one. We'll talk about it.

unique_item_defs.name: Dustveil Wraps
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Layered cloth, stained in the shape of a very long road.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Chest (Int/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Sandglass Pendant
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: The sand inside never finishes falling.
unique_item_defs.label: Necklace (Agi/Int)

unique_item_defs.name: Dunewalker's Crossbow
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Lightweight, accurate, and forgiving of sand in the mechanism.
unique_item_defs.label: Crossbow (Agi/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Crawler-Shell Cuirass
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Heavy. Hot. Excellent against things that bite.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Chest (Str/Sta)

quests.title: The Cinderjaw Problem
quests.description: There is a stretch of valley far to the south-west where the ground itself is burnt: the Cinderjaw Wastes. Ember wisps drift there like loose sparks, ashback basilisks sleep on the warm stone, and something called Smolderhide has been seen walking at night with fire on its back. Elder Kuraw wants it dealt with before the wastes creep any closer to the lake. This is the hardest thing he has ever asked of a recruit. He asks it quietly.
quests.accept_text: Go south, past the lake, and keep the road under your feet until it stops being a road. Don't fight on the black stone. It holds heat. Smolderhide will find you - it always finds you. Be ready when it does.
quests.turn_in_text: Smolderhide, dead. Then the valley's dangerous things are done, or as done as they get. You have the look of someone who survived a lot. That's the only graduation I recognize.

unique_item_defs.name: Cinderforged Greathelm
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: It's a bucket with ambitions. They're mostly justified.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Helm (Str)

unique_item_defs.name: Ashwalker's Jerkin
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Singed in all the right places. Tough in all the others.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Chest (Str/Agi)

unique_item_defs.name: Ember-Stitched Legguards
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: The seams still glow faintly at night.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Legs (Agi/Int)

unique_item_defs.name: Cinder Signet
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A red-hot idea you had once, cooled into metal.
unique_item_defs.label: Ring (Int)

quests.title: Grosk's Trophy
quests.description: Grosk the Younger has decided that a real orc leaves the valley with a trophy, and he has decided on Sandfang - the pale, scarred jackal that haunts the Windrift Dunes and has outrun every hunter in the valley. He has not decided how he'll do it, which is why he is asking you. Thin the pack, find the old one, and bring him proof. His mother has opinions about the whole idea. She may be right. Do it anyway.
quests.accept_text: It's a white one. Scar over the left eye. Quick as anything, but it's old - old things get careless. I'd do it myself except... my mother. You understand.
quests.turn_in_text: You actually did it! She's going to be so angry. I'm going to tell everyone you did it, I swear - I'll say it was both of us. Here, take something. For the trouble.

unique_item_defs.name: Dunestalker's Longspear
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Longer than a shopping cart and nearly as steerable.
unique_item_defs.label: Polearm (Str)

unique_item_defs.name: Trophy-Hunter's Sling
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Not exactly a gentleman's weapon. You're not exactly a gentleman.
unique_item_defs.label: Thrown (Agi/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Dune-Stalker's Cloak
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Sand-coloured, sand-stained, sand-proof.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloak (Agi)

unique_item_defs.name: Grosk's Lucky Bracers
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: He wore them for a day. They did not feel lucky.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Bracers (Str/Spi)

quests.title: Fizzcrank's Shiny Problem
quests.description: Fizzcrank Sprocketspin has discovered that the crystals lining the Burning Blade Coven give off a heat he finds personally offensive: it should not be possible to be warm and wrong at the same time. He wants five shards - tiny ones, pocket-sized, the kind the acolytes carry on their belts - to measure what's wrong with them. He is fairly sure it's not dangerous. He is also fairly sure it was on fire a moment ago.
quests.accept_text: The acolytes keep them on their belts. Don't touch them with bare hands. Use tongs. Or a stick. Or a different hand. I'll be here, doing my own science.
quests.turn_in_text: Oh, that's wonderful. That's - oh no. Okay, it's fine, nothing to see. Take whatever you want from the bench - I'm going to be busy.

unique_item_defs.name: Sprocketspin Rangefinder
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: It clicks. You aren't sure what it measures. You choose to trust it.
unique_item_defs.label: Gun (Agi/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Goggles of Questionable Safety
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Rated for two explosions. You've already worn it through four.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Helm (Agi/Int)

unique_item_defs.name: Shard-Studded Gauntlets
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Tiny crystals hum at the knuckles. Do not make a fist near anything flammable.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Gloves (Int/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Fuse-Wire Ring
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Shorter fuse, bigger idea.
unique_item_defs.label: Ring (Int/Sta)

quests.title: Silk for Rhaka
quests.description: Rhaka's son went up the ridge to prove himself last week, and he came back. She'd like to keep it that way, and in her experience the surest way to do that is a good cloak. Not a ratty hide thing - silk, strong enough to turn a scorpid sting, the kind the webspinners in the Den spin in their halls. Six spools. She has the loom. She does not have the nerve to go into that cave.
quests.accept_text: Spools, from the webspinners. They keep them at their backs. Don't take the loose thread - it's sticky. The spools are what you want. Be careful. Please.
quests.turn_in_text: This is good silk. Strong. Feel that? That'll turn a stinger. Here - I made extra. It's the least I can do for the one who made me less afraid.

unique_item_defs.name: Rhaka's Silkwoven Mantle
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Made by a mother who has worried a lot and sewn better for it.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Shoulders (Sta/Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Mother's Travel Cloak
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: It's not magic. It's just very well made.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloak (Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Den-Silk Slippers
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Quiet on stone, soft on blisters.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Boots (Int/Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Silk-Laced Marching Boots
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: She added one extra stitch for luck.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Boots (Agi/Spi)

quests.title: Mother of the Nest
quests.description: The scorpids you've been killing have a mother. Broodmother Sarrix has held the north-eastern nest for longer than the Horde has held the valley, and she is the reason the workers keep coming. Nakhtar doesn't want you to fight her. He wants you to fight everything around her first, and then to decide whether you're ready. He suspects you'll go anyway.
quests.accept_text: Northeast. Past the camp road, where the sand turns dark. She rarely leaves the nest and never leaves it unguarded. Be sure of your health before you commit to the fight. It's long, and it's patient.
quests.turn_in_text: Sarrix is dead. The nest will keep moving without her for a season and then settle. You did something this valley has needed for a long time. I won't forget it.

unique_item_defs.name: Broodmother's Stinger
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A real stinger, dried and shaped. Still faintly twitches.
unique_item_defs.label: Dagger (Agi)

unique_item_defs.name: Queenhide Tunic
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: The hide shrugs off everything except compliments.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Chest (Agi/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Nestbreaker Legplates
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Heavy, and it doesn't care.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Legs (Str/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Chitin Aegis
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A slab of broodmother carapace on a strap.
unique_item_defs.label: Shield (Sta)

quests.title: Disrupting the Ritual
quests.description: The familiars were only the bait. Deeper in the Coven, the Burning Blade have been drawing a circle - a real one, with a real summoning, in a hall the Valley Grunt has only seen from a distance. Initiates guard the approaches and ritual guards stand between them and any fool with a sword. Break up the ritual before it finishes, or there won't be a Baneshadow to fight. There will be something worse.
quests.accept_text: Initiates in the outer halls. Ritual guards in the hall with the circle. Kill the guards first if you can - they're the ones who'll finish it. I'll hold the road behind you.
quests.turn_in_text: The circle's broken. The air smells normal again, and I didn't know I'd been smelling it. There's only one left to finish. Take this and go.

unique_item_defs.name: Shattered Ritual Blade
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Cracked down the middle and still sharp enough. Both halves are on the wall of your room back home.
unique_item_defs.label: Sword (Str)

unique_item_defs.name: Acolyte's Sash
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: The sigil on the buckle is facing the wrong way. It's fine.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Belt (Int/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Fel-Scorched Greaves
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Blackened but sturdy. Don't kick anything flammable.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Boots (Str/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Coven-Marked Band
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: The mark has faded. The strength hasn't.
unique_item_defs.label: Ring (Str/Agi)
